articles.title: Reset VPN password
articles.body: Northstar demo policy: Open the employee password portal, choose Reset password, verify your identity with the registered factor, and set a new password. Reconnect the VPN with the updated password. Never send your password to this assistant. If identity verification fails, raise an IT ticket.

articles.title: VPN connection troubleshooting
articles.body: Check that your internet connection works. Close and reopen the approved VPN client. Record the exact error message and try reconnecting once. If it still fails, create a ticket with the error and approximate start time. These are fictional organization instructions.

articles.title: Laptop performance
articles.body: Save your work and restart the laptop. Check available disk space using system settings. If the problem persists, describe the affected application and symptoms in a support ticket. Do not disable security software.

articles.title: Printer troubleshooting
articles.body: Check paper and ink or toner indicators. Confirm that you selected the correct printer. Record any display error. Raise a ticket if the issue persists.

articles.title: Email sign-in help
articles.body: Confirm that you are using your work account. Retry sign-in through the approved mail application. If your account is locked or the second factor is unavailable, raise an IT support ticket. Do not share verification codes.

articles.title: Office WiFi connection
articles.body: Confirm that WiFi is enabled and choose the approved office network. Reconnect once. If the connection fails, include the office location and displayed error in your ticket.
